raw_text: Following the Shopian encounter, internet has been shut down in South Kashmir but protest coordination continues through VPN tunnels. OSINT analysis shows timed message bursts across Telegram and X at regular intervals, suggesting automated scheduling. Stone pelting incidents reported at three locations. This is a pattern seen repeatedly in Kashmir encounters.
